lines.en: I hop branch to branch and never touch ground.

lines.zh: 这段树皮太滑，我挪慢点
lines.en: This bark is slick, I move slowly.
Wings folded, I try a couple of steps.
That thin twig sways badly.
I walk the fence line, it is safer.

lines.zh: 地上的面包屑我看见了
lines.en: I spotted bread crumbs on the ground.
My claws grip the hanging vine.

lines.zh: 树冠那边有别的鸟在叫
lines.en: Another bird is calling from the canopy.
I peck as I go, hunting for seeds.
This route leads to my nest.
The wind blew and I nearly slipped.
My claws feel cold on the wet dirt.
A cat ahead, I climb into the tree.
I trot after a falling leaf.

lines.zh: 我蹦到下一根枝，回头看看。
lines.en: I hop to the next branch and look back.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，才继续走。
lines.en: I shake my wings before going on.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛理顺，一根根来
lines.en: I smooth my feathers, one by one.
The sun is right, I will bask a while.

lines.zh: 这片林子只有我这种颜色
lines.en: Only my color lives in this wood.
I tilt my head toward worms in the soil.
My throat tickles, I want to sing.
One straw in my nest sits crooked.
That cloud looks like a giant bird.
I stand on one leg to save effort.
A beetle is hiding in the bark.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上很小
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is tiny.
The wind keeps flipping my feathers up.
I wait for the fruit to ripen.

lines.zh: 你手心里是不是有种子
lines.en: Do you have seeds in your palm?
I tilt my head at your hat.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就退一步
lines.en: One step from you, one step back from me.
Your pocket rattles like grain.
I am not afraid, but I keep distance.

lines.zh: 你伸手太慢了，我看得清
lines.en: Your hand moves slowly, I see it clearly.
Stand still a moment, let me look.
Your voice sounds like coaxing.
I know the color of your hat brim.
One move from you and I fly up.
How long have you stood under my tree?

lines.zh: 我们这样对视，谁也不让
lines.en: We stare like this, neither giving way.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的食
lines.en: Your shadow covers my food.

lines.zh: 我眨了一只眼，你看见没
lines.en: I blinked one eye, did you catch that?
My feathers are scattered on the ground.
My wing bent, I cannot fly high.
Who threw the stone that hit me?
I have only six points, stop chasing me.
I hide in the leaves and tremble.
The pain twisted my song out of tune.
I flutter upward toward the treetop.

lines.zh: 我的巢就在上面，别过来
lines.en: My nest is up there, stay away.
My claws can barely hold the branch.
I dropped into the grass and cannot move.
Seeds on the ground, I will come down.
Those wheat seeds rolled near your hand.

lines.zh: 我跳到你脚边，只差一点
lines.en: I hop to your feet, almost there.
You open your palm, and I hesitate.
These seeds smell better than wild fruit.
I peck once, then look up at you.
Move back, then I dare to eat.
The husk is too hard for me to crack.
If your hand stays still, I come closer.
Full now, I hop back up the tree.
You brushed the branch and startled me off.
You bumped into my nest.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫到你的耳朵
lines.en: My wing grazed your ear.
You stepped on and crushed an eggshell.
Stop shaking this tree, I cannot keep balance.
You knocked loose one tail feather.
I flew right into your shoulder.
You parted the bush and scared the insects.
That cost me a few feathers.
We collided, and both of us froze.

lines.zh: 我在枝头唱得比平时响
lines.en: I sing louder than usual from the branch.
She landed on the branch next to mine.
I picked the softest blade of grass.
The nest needs one more layer.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛颜色够不够亮
lines.en: Are my feathers bright enough for her?
She preened the feathers on my neck.
We hop together on the forked branch.
Four eggs, and she decides that.

lines.zh: 别的雄鸟别靠近这棵树
lines.en: Other males should stay off this tree.
She has leaned her head against mine.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒掉落的种子
lines.en: I pick up a fallen seed.
This stem is too thick for my beak.

lines.zh: 亮片片不是我吃的东西
lines.en: The shiny flake is not food for me.
I tuck a feather into the nest.
A berry dropped, and I pick it up.
I use a small stone to hone my beak.
Thread tangled on my beak, how awful.
With this twig I cannot fly high.
This piece of bread is far too big.
I hide it in a crack in the bark.

lines.zh: 树皮里那条虫子我听见了
lines.en: I hear a grub moving under the bark.
That leaf is moving, something is there.
A moth just flew past me.

lines.zh: 地上的面包屑，我先看到
lines.en: The crumbs on the ground are mine first.
That beetle ducked beneath the stone.
Ripe fruit has fallen all over the ground.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那根晃动的草
lines.en: I fix my eyes on the swaying grass.
The ants are marching, I watch them.
That snail is crawling far too slowly.
A bug fell into my water dish.
I crouch with my wings half open.
The moment it moves, I take off.

lines.zh: 我落在它背后那根枝上
lines.en: I land on the branch behind it.
My head inches closer, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它藏进叶背，我也挪过去
lines.en: It hid under a leaf, so I shift too.
I wait for it to crawl from the crack.
My wings make no sound at all.
I circle halfway around it.
When it stops, I freeze as well.
The wind helps, it cannot smell me.
One peck, and I rarely miss.
My claws pin it, then I peck again.
My wings batter it until it is dazed.
This peck is just enough to crack the shell.
I shake the grub twice in my beak.
Six points of health, and still I strike.
The peck flipped it onto its back.
I hop up and peck from above.
The bite was light, but it got scared.
After the strike I fly back up.
I poke my head out of the nest.

lines.zh: 这片林子的鸟都这个色
lines.en: Every bird here shares my coloring.
I hatched from the egg not long ago.

lines.zh: 这棵树的果子熟得正好
lines.en: The fruit on this tree is just ripe.

lines.zh: 我的叫声传遍了整片林
lines.en: My call carries across the whole wood.
I land on a newly grown branch.
This fork blocks wind and sheds rain.
I spread my wings for the first time.
The woods are quiet, good for nesting.
I shake the dew off my feathers.
The smoke stings my eyes shut.
I fell from the branch into the leaves.
Water reached my wings, I flap wildly.
The blast blew my nest apart.
An arrow grazed my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我按在枝上
lines.en: A strange force pressed me to the branch.

lines.zh: 种子吃完了，我叫得发虚
lines.en: The seeds ran out and my song is weak.
The thunder drove me into my nest.
The tree is gone, I can only keep flying.
